title: Canonical framework slug definitions
description: Centralized library of every canonical `*Slug` definition referenced across the harness's contracts. Every framework entity named by a slug uses the same URL-safe form (lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens: `[a-z0-9-]+`) and is also the filename stem used to locate the entity's definition — except `templateSlug` (nested `/`-separated path segments, since templates are organized per layer/actor, not in a flat directory) and `nodeSlug` (a workspace path segment, which may embed `<name>` VARIABLE placeholders). This file has no root shape of its own: it exists solely to be `$ref`'d — in-repo via `#/definitions/<slug>`, cross-file via `gsmarc://saf/contracts/slugs/v1#/definitions/<slug>`.

workflowSlug.description: URL-safe slug naming a workflow — the stem of the workflow configuration filename (e.g. verification from verification.workflow.conf.yaml).

stepSlug.description: URL-safe slug naming a step within a workflow. Must be unique within the workflow; used in `stepCondition`'s `step` and in the run log.

conditionSlug.description: URL-safe slug naming a condition, unique within its step; it appears in the run log's conditions[] entries.

agentSlug.description: URL-safe slug naming a framework agent — the value of the agent file's frontmatter `name` and the stem of the agent filename (e.g. product-manager from agents/product-manager.agent.md).

artifactSlug.description: URL-safe slug naming an artifact kind — the stem of the artifact schema filename (e.g. product-vision from artifacts/product-vision.artifact.schema.json).

skillSlug.description: URL-safe slug naming a skill — the stem of the skill filename under `FRAMEWORK_SKILLS_DIR` (e.g. code-review from skills/code-review.skill.md).

instructionSlug.description: URL-safe slug naming an instruction file — the stem of the instruction filename under `FRAMEWORK_INSTRUCTIONS_DIR` (e.g. review-handoff from instructions/review-handoff.instructions.md).

roleSlug.description: URL-safe slug naming a role — the role slug declared in `conf/access-control-list.conf.yaml` and referenced by actors.

templateSlug.description: URL-safe slug naming an artifact template — the stem of the template filename under `FRAMEWORK_TEMPLATES_DIR`, path segments included (e.g. `layers/portfolio/actors/business-owner/artifacts/epic` from `templates/layers/portfolio/actors/business-owner/artifacts/epic.artifact-template.md`). Unlike other framework slugs, nested path segments are part of the slug — templates are organized per layer/actor, not in a flat directory.

nodeSlug.description: URL-safe path segment for a workspace node — this node's OWN segment only; the full workspace-relative path is deduced by concatenating ancestor slugs top-down. May embed one or more `<name>` VARIABLE placeholders (e.g. `<epic-slug>`) — angle brackets are the variable-marking syntax — optionally mixed with literal text (e.g. `<epic-slug>.epic.md`, `pi-<pi-slug>`). The same variable name may recur across a node and its descendants' slugs to bind consistently (e.g. a folder's `<epic-slug>` and its child file's `<epic-slug>.epic.md` share one binding).
